deals.evidence: has acquired the minority stake in the team previously held by Sports Capital Holdings LLC, giving Stillman's group 100% ownership of the Blues
deals.headline: Stillman group buys out last outside stake, owns 100% of the Blues
deals.summary: The local group led by chairman Tom Stillman acquired the minority stake held by Sports Capital Holdings LLC, holding company of the 2006-12 ownership group, giving it 100% of the Blues; NHL approved the deal. Stake size and price not disclosed.

deals.evidence: has completed the transfer of his partial ownership stake to Michael W. Riney
deals.headline: David Steward transfers Blues stake to Michael Riney
deals.summary: David Steward, an original member of Stillman's 2012 group, transferred his partial ownership stake to Michael W. Riney (founder and managing director of QRM Capital). Stake and price not disclosed.

deals.evidence: has been sold to his niece, Carolyn Kindle
deals.headline: Andy Taylor's Blues stake sold to niece Carolyn Kindle
deals.summary: The minority ownership stake of Andy Taylor, an original member of the 2012 group, was sold to his niece Carolyn Kindle, CEO of St. Louis CITY SC. Stake and price not disclosed.

name: St. Louis Blues Hockey Club
notes: Revenue, operating income (EBITDA) and player expenses are Forbes estimates for 2024-25 (USD, net of revenue sharing and arena debt service); valuation is Forbes enterprise value calculated December 2025 (Forbes lists owner Tom Stillman, purchased 2012 for $180M, championships 1). Ownership: members are listed on the Blues front-office page and in the Jan 2025 release; no member's percentage is published, so stakes are null. The 2012 purchase predates the 2015 deal window and has no deal row. Arena: Enterprise Center (opened October 8, 1994 per enterprisecenter.com, which also says the City of St. Louis leased the site and assigned development rights to Kiel Center Partners, LP); who owns the building today is not stated on a page read, so stadium_owner is null. The Blues' front office lists a VP & GM of Enterprise Center & Stifel Theatre, i.e. the team runs the building. Enterprise naming rights: 15-year deal effective July 1, 2018. Missing: arena capacity (not on a citable page read), honours (2019 Stanley Cup not read on a citable page beyond Forbes' 'Championships 1'), social, attendance, sponsors.

ownership_summary: Owned by an all-local St. Louis ownership group led by Chairman and Governor Tom Stillman, which bought the Blues in 2012 and in June 2019 bought the remaining minority stake held by Sports Capital Holdings LLC (the 2006-12 owners' holding company), taking it to 100%. Members' individual stakes are not published; no fund or institutional investor holds a stake.
